description: Create an explicit NSW funding model registry for State Price per NWAU/HWAU, local health district notes, adjustments, and provenance over time.
completion_policy: Complete-with-gaps means the repository now has a runtime NSWFundingModelRegistry with public-source NSW State Price fixtures for 2025 and 2026, plus fail-closed missing-year handling and a parallel valuation helper. It does not claim full official coverage for all historical NSW years or redistribute restricted service-agreement artefacts.

implemented: runtime NSWFundingModelRegistry API for source-backed years
public NSW State Price rows for 2025 and 2026
fail-closed missing-year handling for unavailable NSW years
parallel valuation helper combining NSW and national prices
not_implemented: full official NSW source coverage for all historical and future years
validated NSW-specific adjustment modelling for every district/network note
redistribution of restricted NSW service-agreement artefacts

gap_register.description: NSW funding-model support now has public-source fixtures for 2025 and 2026, but the archive still does not claim exhaustive historical coverage or redistribution of restricted artefacts.
gap_register.rationale: The track is complete-with-gaps because the public fixtures are source-backed yet deliberately limited to the years and caveats visible in the repository.

remaining_external_gates: official source review for additional historical NSW years
licence review for restricted service-agreement artefacts
district/network-specific adjustment validation beyond the public fixture notes
